systems.owner: the mayor, who with the deputy mayors is civil-status officer (article 93)
systems.tiers: commune; the code says nothing of how the record is made

note: The 2010 local-government code (the capture is an excerpt, cut off at article 204): its one civil-status provision, article 93, makes the mayor and deputies civil-status officers who transcribe and authenticate civil-status acts, and makes the mayor responsible for the commune's civil-status service. It states nothing on digital registration, and civil status is not among the transferable domains listed in article 163.
